title: Extract two additional IWRAM OBJ callbacks
changes: Extend the European OBJ static-list resource with the authenticated callback words at 397fa4 and 397fb8; the guest retains callback selection and execution of mutable IWRAM. All eight bytes were unowned in the E172 sample.
validation: Source e191-callback-source-m460uxk9 and Wine e191-callback-trace-wine-35oh5q8o authenticate and observe both readers. Wine e191-callback-wine-gj6h0gcr preserves 121 other resources and prior OBJ fields, rejects coherent edits, checks altered mirrored and mixed reads and compares two interpreter/native load-and-branch entries.

Wine e191-callback-scene-wine-_vpbz8be matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames with all eight backing bytes altered. Wine e191-callback-cli-wine-fttzwwhr creates, reuses and verifies 123 matching files.
limitations: Both observed ordinary reads used interpreter fallback. Other callbacks, callers and live IWRAM paths, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements were performed. The first build launch 89y445bs used an invalid relative path; e_8ykhv5 was interrupted and k1nk95_g passed.
